 BSF Head Constable Result 2026 for Head Constable (Ministerial) and ASI (Stenographer) posts is expected to be released soon. The Computer-Based Test was conducted on September 2 and 3, 2026, for 1,752 vacancies. Candidates will be able to download the merit list PDF from rectt.bsf.gov.in and check their qualifying status using their roll numbers. Shortlisted candidates will proceed to the Skill Test, which includes a typing test for HCM and a stenography test for ASI Steno. Lavkesh Singh 3 Nov, 2026 Share

 BSF HCM and ASI Steno Result 2026: Important Instructions 
 Border Security Force (BSF) is expected to announce the BSF Head Constable Result 2026 for Head Constable (Ministerial) and Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) Stenographer posts soon. Candidates who appeared for the Computer-Based Test (CBT) will be able to check their qualifying status through the result PDF on the official recruitment website, rectt.bsf.gov.in.
 The recruitment examination was conducted on September 2 and 3, 2026, for a total of 1,752 vacancies. The result is expected to be released as a merit list containing the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the next stage.
 Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF will be eligible to participate in the Skill Test. The requirements for this stage differ for the two posts: Head Constable (Ministerial) candidates will take the typing test, while ASI (Stenographer) candidates will appear for the stenography test.
 Aspirants can check the latest updates about the BSF HCM and ASI Steno Result 2026 and follow the official recruitment portal for the result announcement.
 BSF Head Constable Result 2026: Latest Updates
 BSF conducted the Computer-Based Test for Head Constable (Ministerial) and ASI (Stenographer) posts on September 2 and 3, 2026. The recruitment drive covers 1,752 vacancies across the two posts.
 The result is expected to be published soon. Candidates will be able to download the merit list PDF and search for their roll numbers to determine whether they have qualified for the next stage.
 Before the result announcement, BSF released the provisional answer key, allowing candidates to review their responses. Candidates who want to revisit the answer key and response sheet details can read the BSF Answer Key 2026 update .
 The result will determine which candidates can proceed to the Skill Test. Shortlisted candidates should carefully check the instructions and schedule mentioned in the official notification.

 BSF HCM and ASI Steno Result 2026 PDF
 BSF is expected to release the HCM and ASI Steno Result 2026 in PDF format on its official recruitment portal. The merit list will contain the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted after the Computer-Based Test.
 Candidates can check their qualifying status by opening the PDF and searching for their examination roll number. If the roll number appears in the list, the candidate will be eligible to participate in the next stage of recruitment.
 Candidates will not need to enter their login credentials if the result is published as a downloadable merit list PDF. They can use the search option available in the PDF viewer to locate their roll number.
 The direct result link will be updated here once BSF officially releases the merit list.
 How to Download BSF Head Constable Result 2026?
 Candidates can follow the steps below to check and download the BSF HCM and ASI Steno Result 2026:
 Visit the official BSF recruitment website at rectt.bsf.gov.in.
 Open the recruitment or results section on the homepage.
 Search for the notification related to the Head Constable (Ministerial) and ASI (Stenographer) Result 2026.
 Click on the result or merit list PDF link.
 Open the PDF displayed on the screen.
 Press Ctrl+F or use the search option in the PDF viewer.
 Enter your examination roll number.
 Check whether your roll number appears in the list of qualified candidates.
 Download the result PDF and save it for future reference.
 Candidates who want to review the earlier examination stage can also refer to the BSF HCM and ASI Steno Admit Card 2026 details .
 BSF HCM and ASI Steno Cut-Off 2026
 The official cut-off marks for the BSF HCM and ASI Steno examination are expected to be announced along with or through the result-related notification. The cut-off may vary depending on factors such as the number of vacancies, examination difficulty and candidates' performance.
 Candidates should distinguish between minimum qualifying marks and the final cut-off. Minimum qualifying marks represent the basic score required to be considered, whereas the cut-off determines the marks needed for shortlisting under the applicable recruitment criteria.
 Aspirants should wait for the official notification before treating any unofficial cut-off estimate as final.
 What After BSF Head Constable Result 2026?
 Candidates who qualify in the CBT will proceed to the Skill Test. The test requirements are different for Head Constable (Ministerial) and ASI (Stenographer) posts.
 Head Constable (Ministerial): Candidates will appear for the prescribed typing test.
 ASI (Stenographer): Candidates will undergo the stenography skill test.
 After the Skill Test, shortlisted candidates will have to complete the subsequent recruitment formalities, including document verification and the medical examination, as applicable under the selection process.
 Candidates should continue practising the relevant typing or stenography skills while waiting for the result. They should also keep checking the official portal for updates regarding the next stage.
 BSF Recruitment 2026: Other Important Updates
 BSF conducts recruitment for several posts, including Constable, Head Constable and other technical and non-technical positions. Candidates preparing for different BSF examinations can follow the BSF Exam 2026 recruitment and selection details to understand the broader recruitment process.
 For aspirants interested in other Head Constable vacancies, the BSF Head Constable RO and RM Admit Card 2026 provides information about the separate Radio Operator and Radio Mechanic recruitment. Candidates should note that these are different posts from HCM and ASI Steno.
 Similarly, candidates preparing for other BSF vacancies can check the BSF Constable Tradesman Result 2025 for updates on that recruitment cycle.
 For broader information about recruitment in the Central Armed Police Forces, candidates can also read about the UPSC CAPF Final Result 2026 and the Agniveer reservation in CAPF recruitment .
 Candidates exploring other uniformed services can also refer to the SSC GD Best Post 2027 guide , which discusses the different forces covered under SSC GD recruitment, including BSF.
 BSF HCM and ASI Steno Result 2026: Important Instructions
 Check the result only through the official BSF recruitment portal.
 Download the correct merit list PDF for the HCM and ASI Steno recruitment.
 Use your examination roll number to search for your qualifying status.
 Read the result notification carefully for Skill Test instructions.
 Prepare for the relevant typing or stenography test.
 Keep the required documents ready for subsequent recruitment stages.
 Save a copy of the result PDF for future reference.
 Regularly check the official website for updates from BSF.
